elsewhere.note: You are of your father, the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and doesn’t stand in the truth, because…
May it never be! Yes, let God be found true, but every man a liar. As it is written, “that you might be justified in your words, and might prevail when you…
for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave-traders, for liars, for perjurers, and for any other thing contrary to the sound doctrine,
One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons.”
If we say that we haven’t sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
